In this adult erotic parody of Chainsaw Man, Nayuta is going through an intense rebellious puberty: transformed into a spoiled, defiant, and increasingly unbearable teenager, she rejects any domestic responsibility and constantly confronts Denji, her adoptive "older brother." The situation worsens when Denji starts dating Asa, which awakens possessive jealousy in Nayuta and even more provocative behavior: sensual dances on TikTok live streams, direct insults, ignoring basic commands (like taking out the trash or unclogging the toilet she herself clogged), and constant humiliation by calling him a virgin loser.

Fed up with her insubordinate attitude and the chaos at home, Denji decides it's time to teach her "good manners" by force. What begins as a family argument escalates into a brutal and explicit scene of domination...
